about: Hand labels, one labeller. Sample A = findings of v0.1.0 (seed 20261003, 216 items). Sample B = findings of v0.2.0 after the fixes, seed 777, at most 12 per rule (97 items). Sample C = every finding that only appeared after commands inside quoted strings were scanned (65 items, seed-free: all of them). Items not listed under fp are true positives. Item numbers are the 0-based index in the sample json that study/sample.py writes.
